title: b10669
description: sycl: bind the f16 KV cache in place for the oneDNN SDPA path ( #27468 ) Measured at a live KV length of 34816 (32768 depth plus one 2048 ubatch), on Qwen3.8 27B Q4_K_S: per tensor 4 * 34816 * 256 * 2 B = 71.3 MB staged per call K and V, so 2x = 142.6 MB traffic per call read once, write once = 285.2 MB traffic per ubatch 285.2 MB * 16 calls = 4.56 GB One ubatch is one ggml_cgraph submission (llama_context::process_ubatch -> graph_compute), so that 4.56 GB is the cost of a single 2048-token pref
